Why PROHOR

Motherhood is a journey. Care shouldn’t feel like a puzzle.

  • Less scattered. More connected.

    Keep records, questions and visits in the same story.

  • Fewer barriers. More ways in.

    Language, small text and voice-only tasks shouldn’t stand between you and care.

  • Beyond birth. Still about you.

    A baby’s beginning is another chapter in the mother’s care.

About 4,000 maternal deaths in Bangladesh in 2023; the maternal mortality ratio was 79% lower than in 2000. UN estimates · WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA · 2025 (opens in a new tab)

1 in 3 women who died of maternal causes had sought care at three or more places. BMMS 2016 · Journal of Global Health, 2023 (opens in a new tab)
